entities.name: Lilabati Bhattacharjee
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lilabati Bhattacharjee was a mineralogist, crystallographer and a physicist. She studied with the scientist Satyendra Nath Bose, and completed her MSc in physics from the University College of Science and Technology, University of Calcutta in 1951.
